domains.label: Customers
domains.description: Consultation, listing and profile management for customers and their associated profile data.

domains.label: Interaction logs
domains.description: Customer interaction histories and acknowledgement of interactions.

domains.label: Notifications
domains.description: Unacknowledged notification counts associated with customers.

elements.name: GET /customers/{customerId}
elements.role: Retrieves a customer profile by customer ID.

elements.name: PUT /customers/{customerId}
elements.role: Updates the profile of the customer identified by the path parameter.

elements.name: GET /interaction-logs/{customerId}
elements.role: Retrieves the interaction log for the specified customer.

elements.name: PATCH /interaction-logs/{customerId}
elements.role: Acknowledges the customer's interactions up to the supplied interaction ID.

elements.name: GET /notifications
elements.role: Lists all unacknowledged notifications.

elements.name: GET /customers
elements.role: Lists customers with optional filtering and pagination.

elements.name: CustomerId
